info.title: Get Invoice Status
info.description: Invoice submission status allows the client to inquire on the status of their invoice submission. A response will be sent back to the client advising the latest status of their submitted invoices.

get.summary: This API would be used by the CashPro Client to request a status for their invoice submissions.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Identifies the payload content as JSON

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: An unexpired access token to be used for this request (ex. "Bearer [value]").

parameters.name: si
parameters.description: CashPro Trade Identifier used to identify the submitters request

invoicestatus.description:
Status of the invoice submission

'Invoice Status': 'Pending'
'Status Code': 200
'StatusDescription': 'Invoice submitted successfully'
'Description': 'Invoice is pending in CashPro Trade and ready to be submitted'

'Invoice Status;: 'Submitted'
'Status Code': 200
'StatusDescription': 'Discount Request in Process'
'Description': 'Invoice is in the process of being discounted by Bank of America'

'Invoice Status;: 'Discounted'
'Status Code': 200
'StatusDescription': 'Invoice Discounted'
'Description': 'Invoice was discounted by Bank of America and funds have been disbursed'

'Invoice Status;: 'Matured'
'Status Code': 200
'StatusDescription': 'Invoice Matured'
'Description': 'Invoice has matured and Bank of America has received funds'

'Invoice Status;: 'Error'
'Status Code': 200
'StatusDescription': 'Duplicate SubmitterRef'
'Description': 'Duplicate SubmitterRef'

statuscode.description: Status code sent for the POST submission i.e 200, 400, 401, 403

statusDescription.description: Additional status information of the invoice submission

submissionIdentification.description: Unique transaction identifier as assigned by the bank

obligationNumber.description: Transaction identifier for the discount request

discountCharge.description: Banks fees for the invoice within the discount request

Fundsdue.description: Funds due to the bank at maturity for the Invoice
